items.name: Learn Bright
items.description: Teacher-created animated lessons covering science, history, math, and language arts. Almost every video pairs with free downloadable worksheets and lesson plans on learnbright.org.

items.name: Free School
items.description: Calm, gentle mini-documentaries exploring famous artists, classical music, world history, and nature. Uses soothing narration and real imagery instead of loud, fast-paced cartoons.

items.name: SciShow Kids
items.description: Answers kids' everyday "why" and "how" questions—from how volcanoes erupt to why leaves change color—using fun host explanations and simple home science experiments.

items.name: Crash Course Kids
items.description: Fast-paced, curriculum-aligned 5th-grade science series covering Earth science, space, engineering, and ecosystems in clear, energetic 4-minute episodes.

items.name: National Geographic Kids
items.description: Exciting wildlife footage, weird-but-true facts, and explorer adventures that introduce kids to animals, geography, and conservation around the globe.

items.name: Peekaboo Kidz (Dr. Binocs Show)
items.description: Friendly animated character Dr. Binocs explains how the human body, weather, inventions, and history work using colorful, easy-to-follow storytelling.

items.name: TED-Ed
items.description: Award-winning short animated lessons created by educators and animators that spark curiosity in science, history, literature, and brain-teasing logic riddles.

items.name: Numberblocks
items.description: BBC-produced musical animations where friendly block characters teach counting, addition, multiplication, and number sense visually so young kids truly understand how numbers work.

items.name: Alphablocks
items.description: Companion series to Numberblocks where animated letter characters join together to sound out words, making phonics and early reading intuitive and memorable.

items.name: Art for Kids Hub
items.description: Real-time, step-by-step drawing tutorials led by a dad and his kids. Encourages screen-free creativity with paper and markers while building focus and confidence.

items.name: Smile and Learn
items.description: Teacher-designed animated videos covering vocabulary, emotions, basic math, geography, and life skills in a warm, accessible style for preschoolers and early elementary kids.

items.name: Storyline Online
items.description: Celebrated actors read beloved children's picture books aloud alongside gentle animations, helping kids fall in love with stories, vocabulary, and expressive reading.
